notes:

- **Insectarium:** Dec 28 is a Monday, so it would be closed that day. The other three days fall on Sunday, Tuesday and Wednesday.
- **Science Centre:** Its own holiday-hours pages that I found were from earlier years, so I did not use them.
- **Zoo Ecomuseum:** The page's hours table didn't come through, so I left out the hours. The zoo is outdoors, on the west end of the island.
- **Biodôme:** It is also run by Espace pour la vie. I left it out because its own page only showed an October week's hours, not winter hours.
